metadata.title: European Basketball Coaches from Wikipedia
metadata.scope: Country-by-team English Wikipedia categories associated with European domestic, regional and continental basketball leagues.
metadata.ratingExplanation: Head-coach honors receive full competition-specific value. Assistant, consultant and youth honors receive reduced value. Player achievements remain in the database but receive zero coaching points. Experience is added and raw scores are percentile-ranked across the scraped European pool. The 99th percentile and above is capped at 90.

biography.introduction: Patrick Elzie (born November 22, 1960) is an American-German professional basketball coach and former professional player. He played collegiately at Holy Cross and professionally in Europe. He acquired German citizenship in 1994.

biography.introduction: Orhun Ene (born 1 February 1967 in Erzurum, Turkey) is a Turkish former professional basketball player and coach. coaches.name: Alexander Ermolinskij
sourceRootCategories: Category:Basketball coaches in Iceland by team

biography.introduction: Alexander Pavlovich Ermolinskij (Russian: Александр Павлович Ермолинский; born November 11, 1959) is an Ukraninan-Icelandic basketball coach and a former basketball player. He was an assistant coach for Nadezhda Orenburg from 2010 to 2021. He played for both the Soviet Union national basketball team and Icelandic national basketball team.

coaches.name: Pavel Ermolinskij
sourceRootCategories: Category:Basketball coaches in Iceland by team

image.caption: Pavel Ermolinskij with KR in February 2015.

biography.introduction: Pavel Ermolinskij (born 25 January 1987) is an Icelandic basketball coach and former player of Russian descent, a member of the Icelandic national team. He played in the Spanish Liga ACB for several seasons, winning the Spanish King's Cup in 2005. As a player, won the Icelandic championship eight times, seven times with KR, in 2011 and 2014 to 2019, and in 2022 with Valur. In 2023, he guided Tindastóll to their first Icelandic championship in his first year as a head coach.
